## Appearance

He is a tall man, standing over six feet in height. His frame is notably strongly built.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER IV NED LAND P8](../source/v01-c04.md#nw-v01-c04-p0008)_

## Personality

Ned Land is a grave and taciturn harpooner who possesses an uncommon quickness of hand and wonderful dexterity. While he is capable of great coolness, audacity, and cunning, he is also known to be impetuous, impatient, and occasionally violent when contradicted. His physical power is evident, and he demonstrates a particular skill in preparing food. Currently, he is driven by a persistent craving for meat and a strong desire to escape the [Nautilus](../codex/tech.md#nautilus). These traits define his character as he navigates the challenges of his confinement.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER IV NED LAND P7](../source/v01-c04.md#nw-v01-c04-p0007), [v1 CHAPTER IV NED LAND P8](../source/v01-c04.md#nw-v01-c04-p0008), [v1 CHAPTER V AT A VENTURE P0](../source/v01-c05.md#nw-v01-c05-p0000), [v1 CHAPTER VIII MOBILIS IN MOBILI P7](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0007), [v1 CHAPTER VIII MOBILIS IN MOBILI P33](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0033), [v1 CHAPTER IX NED LAND’S TEMPERS P19](../source/v01-c09.md#nw-v01-c09-p0019), +6 more_

## History

A harpooner of Quebecois descent, Ned Land joined the crew of the [Abraham Lincoln](../codex/tech.md#abraham-lincoln) to hunt a mysterious sea monster. After successfully harpooning the creature, he was thrown overboard and subsequently captured alongside Professor [Aronnax](../character/professor-aronnax.md) and [Conseil](../character/conseil.md) by the crew of the [Nautilus](../codex/tech.md#nautilus). Held prisoner by the enigmatic Captain [Nemo](../character/captain-nemo.md), Land was forced to adapt to life aboard the advanced submarine, often struggling against his loss of freedom. He participated in various underwater excursions and hunting expeditions on land, though his relationship with his captor remained strained. Following a narrow escape from hostile islanders on the coast of [Papua](../codex/places.md#papua), Land continued to endure confinement as the [Nautilus](../codex/tech.md#nautilus) traversed the oceans. His experiences culminated in his participation in a solemn underwater funeral for a deceased crew member, marking his ongoing, involuntary journey beneath the sea.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER IV NED LAND P9](../source/v01-c04.md#nw-v01-c04-p0009), [v1 CHAPTER IV NED LAND P14](../source/v01-c04.md#nw-v01-c04-p0014), [v1 CHAPTER IV NED LAND P15](../source/v01-c04.md#nw-v01-c04-p0015), [v1 CHAPTER IV NED LAND P16](../source/v01-c04.md#nw-v01-c04-p0016), [v1 CHAPTER IV NED LAND P18](../source/v01-c04.md#nw-v01-c04-p0018), [v1 CHAPTER IV NED LAND P19](../source/v01-c04.md#nw-v01-c04-p0019), +434 more_

## Quotes

> “Well, we must accept,” said the Canadian. “But once more on dry ground, we shall know what to do. Indeed, I shall not be sorry to eat a piece of fresh venison.”
>
> — Ned Land — [v1 CHAPTER XIV A NOTE OF INVITATION P25](../source/v01-c14.md#nw-v01-c14-p0025)

> "The Captain must be very sure of his route, for I see there pieces of coral that would do for its keel if it only touched them slightly."
>
> — Ned Land — [v1 CHAPTER XIX TORRES STRAITS P13](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0013)

> "Sir, you may believe me when I tell you that this piece of iron will navigate neither on nor under the sea again; it is only fit to be sold for its weight. I think, therefore, that the time has come to part company with Captain Nemo."
>
> — Ned Land — [v1 CHAPTER XIX TORRES STRAITS P34](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0034)

> "But do they know, at least, how to act circumspectly? There is an island; on that island there are trees; under those trees, terrestrial animals, bearers of cutlets and roast beef, to which I would willingly give a trial."
>
> — Ned Land — [v1 CHAPTER XIX TORRES STRAITS P36](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0036)

> “Well said, M. Aronnax,” replied the Canadian, whose teeth seemed sharpened like the edge of a hatchet; “but I will eat tiger—loin of tiger—if there is no other quadruped on this island.”
>
> — Ned Land — [v1 CHAPTER XIX TORRES STRAITS P47](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0047)

## Relationships

### [Captain Nemo](../character/captain-nemo.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/captain-nemo--ned-land.md)

Captain [Nemo](../character/captain-nemo.md) is the captor of Ned Land, having detained him aboard the [Nautilus](../codex/tech.md#nautilus) after the destruction of the [Abraham Lincoln](../codex/tech.md#abraham-lincoln). While [Nemo](../character/captain-nemo.md) provides Ned with food and opportunities to explore the sea, the relationship is defined by Ned's lack of freedom and his status as a prisoner. Tension persists due to Nemo's complete control over Ned's life and his disdain for the terrestrial world to which Ned wishes to return.

- Serves under — captor  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER XIX TORRES STRAITS P40](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0040), [v1 CHAPTER XX A FEW DAYS ON LAND P0](../source/v01-c20.md#nw-v01-c20-p0000), [v1 CHAPTER XXIII THE CORAL KINGDOM P42](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0042)</sub>

### [Conseil](../character/conseil.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/conseil--ned-land.md)

[Conseil](../character/conseil.md) and Ned Land are close companions who have shared the ordeal of being cast overboard from the [Abraham Lincoln](../codex/tech.md#abraham-lincoln) and subsequently abducted by the crew of the [Nautilus](../codex/tech.md#nautilus). They remain fellow captives and comrades, relying on each other for support while confined within the submarine. Their bond is rooted in their shared history as passengers and their mutual struggle to survive in an alien environment.

- Comrade of — fellow passenger on the Nautilus  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER VII AN UNKNOWN SPECIES OF WHALE P59](../source/v01-c07.md#nw-v01-c07-p0059), [v1 CHAPTER VIII MOBILIS IN MOBILI P1](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0001), [v1 CHAPTER IX NED LAND’S TEMPERS P22](../source/v01-c09.md#nw-v01-c09-p0022), +12 more</sub>
- Friend of — close companions  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER VIII MOBILIS IN MOBILI P5](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0005), [v1 CHAPTER IX NED LAND’S TEMPERS P19](../source/v01-c09.md#nw-v01-c09-p0019), [v1 CHAPTER XIV A NOTE OF INVITATION P0](../source/v01-c14.md#nw-v01-c14-p0000), +2 more</sub>

### [Professor Aronnax](../character/professor-aronnax.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/ned-land--professor-aronnax.md)

Ned Land and Professor [Aronnax](../character/professor-aronnax.md) are fellow travelers and captives who were brought together after the sinking of the [Abraham Lincoln](../codex/tech.md#abraham-lincoln). They share the experience of being held prisoner by Captain [Nemo](../character/captain-nemo.md) and navigating the unfamiliar life aboard the [Nautilus](../codex/tech.md#nautilus). Their relationship is characterized by their shared status as outsiders within the submarine's crew, often facing the challenges of their captivity as a group.

- Comrade of — fellow traveler and captive  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER VIII MOBILIS IN MOBILI P23](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0023)</sub>
